findings.title: Restore the missing Unity meta before freezing the manifest
findings.originalText: At exact head `6359bf36bfe32bb2b86ce9edab29c2de8c39b52a`, `LocalePreferenceStoreTests.cs` remains in the snapshot while only its `.meta` sidecar is listed as removed. When the cloud workspace first imports this Unity project, Unity will generate a new sidecar and GUID, changing the declared 1036-file input and making the required post-run protected-source/GUID comparison operate on a different candidate. Preserve a fixed sidecar in the snapshot, or explicitly bind and clean this generated file in the preflight contract before treating the manifest as an immutable test input.
